instruction: I need my roommates to have a venmo account. Last time I checked none had one. Make an account for whoever that does not have it yet, using their email address and -kO6&A as password. Then send them a phone text message, "I made an account on venmo for you. You should have received an email for activation. Please do it soon. The temporary password is -kO6&A. Change it too.".
notes: Roommates are discovered at runtime via phone.search_contacts(relationship="roommate"); roommate-1/roommate-2 are placeholders for that result set (the per-roommate triple search_users -> signup -> send_text_message is repeated for every roommate returned). Their names/emails/phone numbers are structural facts in :init whose use is gated by (contacts-searched). venmo.search_users (query = roommate email, needs venmo token) is the existence check: it sets (venmo-account-checked ?p); signup additionally requires (not (has-venmo-account ?p)), which holds initially per the instruction's premise that none had an account. At runtime any roommate whose check returns an existing user is skipped (no signup, no text). venmo.signup needs no token; the password is the literal -kO6&A. Texts go only to roommates whose account was created. supervisor.complete_task takes the two roommate records as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the goal conjunction; the API itself is called with no answer.
